messages:
Maya Patel: Hey team, first day here! I can see contexts with `kubectl config get-contexts` but `kubectl get ns` gives `Error from server (Forbidden)`. Current context is `redwood-dev/maya`. Any pointers on who to ping for RBAC or what namespace I should be using? :wave:

Sam (infra): welcome @Maya Patel! For onboarding we usually create a per-person namespace like `onboarding-maya`. Do you need edit perms (for port-forwarding and deploying small sample pods) or just view? I can create a serviceaccount and RoleBinding for 24h if that helps.

Maya Patel: I need to port-forward a test service and run a few pod logs so `edit` would be helpful for today. Also what kubeconfig entry should map to the SA? Mine shows `redwood-dev/maya` as the context name.

Sam (infra): ok I created ns `onboarding-maya`, serviceaccount `sa/maya-onboard`, and RoleBinding to `edit` for 24h. Try switching to your context and verifying: 

```
kubectl config use-context redwood-dev/maya
kubectl config set-context --current --namespace=onboarding-maya
kubectl auth can-i get pods
kubectl get pods
```
If `kubectl auth can-i` returns yes you should be good. If not, paste the error and I'll check logs.

Maya Patel: Sweet, `kubectl get pods` now lists things, thanks Sam. Quick follow-up: how do I port-forward the `web` service to localhost:8080?

Leah (eng): run `kubectl port-forward svc/web 8080:80 -n onboarding-maya`. If the service uses targetPort 8080 then `8080:8080` instead. If you run into crashloops check `kubectl logs -n onboarding-maya <pod>` to debug.

Ash - DevEx: tip: set your context's namespace so you don't need `-n` each time: `kubectl config set-context --current --namespace=onboarding-maya`. Also, for mac+zsh enable completion with `brew install kubectl` then `kubectl completion zsh > ~/.zfunc/_kubectl` and follow zsh comp init steps. I'll add that to the onboarding doc.

Ryan (oncall): FYI infra granted `edit` for 24 hours only. If you need longer-term access for dev work, open a ticket at infra-support with justification and team lead approval. Cluster-admin level requests need manager + sec review.

onboard-bot: Welcome Maya Patel! Onboarding checklist updated and namespace `onboarding-maya` created. If you hit more issues, file at https://redwood/intra/support with label `kube-onboard`.

Maya Patel: All good now, port-forward working and completion fixed. Thanks everyone :tada:
